basis: The clause is in FC-1, the company's VA contract. Drawings, submittals, daily logs, certified payrolls and pay apps prepared for FC-1 are FCI held on company systems. No size exemption; the only exclusion is for COTS item acquisitions. The substance must be flowed down to subcontracts in which the subcontractor may have FCI (52.204-21(c)); 6 FC-1 subcontractors receive drawings through SYS-01

obligation: FAR 52.204-25 Section 889 prohibition (covered telecommunications and video surveillance equipment)
basis: The clause is in FC-1, and the FC-1 low-voltage scope relocates security cameras and adds a network video recorder. No size exemption. The use prohibition in (b)(2) applies to company use regardless of the contract

obligation: DFARS 252.204-7012 Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting
basis: The company has no DoD contract today, and the expected DoD job involves FCI only; the pre-solicitation notice expects no CUI. Re-check if any DoD contract or document carries covered defense information

obligation: CMMC Program (32 CFR Part 170) and DFARS 252.204-7021

No CUI is held, none was found in the FC-1 contract documents, and the DoD notice expects none. The decision on bidding work that needs CUI is recorded in P03

obligation: Prompt payment for construction contracts (subcontractor payment)
basis: In FC-1. Subcontractors must be paid within 7 days of the company's receipt of payment (52.232-27(c)(1))

obligation: Payrolls and basic records (weekly certified payrolls)
basis: In FC-1. Weekly certified payrolls for the company and its subcontractors; records kept 3 years after completion
